# ViraStack Password (full)

> `@virastack/password` (~1.0.2), accessible, headless password visibility toggle for React. Returns `inputProps` + `btnProps`. No CSS required. Not a strength meter or password generator.

## Install

```bash
npm install @virastack/password
# peers: react, react-dom (>= 18.2)
```

Docs: https://virastack.com/password/docs; Index: https://virastack.com/password/llms.txt; Repo: https://github.com/virastack/password

## Critical rules for agents

1. Spread `inputProps` on the password field and `btnProps` on the toggle control.
2. Keep the toggle as `<button type="button">` (provided via `btnProps`), never submit the form.
3. Do not replace ARIA attributes unless intentionally overriding; defaults are accessibility-first.
4. When `disabled` or `readOnly` is set, the toggle disables automatically.
5. Style freely (Tailwind, Ant Design, Chakra, etc.); the hook is headless.

## Quick start

```tsx
import { useViraPassword } from "@virastack/password"

function Example() {
  const { inputProps, btnProps } = useViraPassword()
  return (
    <div>
      <input {...inputProps} placeholder="Enter password" />
      <button {...btnProps} />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## useViraPassword(options?)

### UseViraPasswordOptions

| Option | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultVisible` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial visibility |
| `icons` | `{ show: ReactNode; hide: ReactNode }` | built-in eye SVGs | Can be icons or text labels |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables input + button |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables toggle |
| `id` | `string` | auto `useId()` | Shared for `aria-controls` |
| `inputProps` | `InputHTMLAttributes` | - | Merged onto generated input props |
| `btnProps` | `ButtonHTMLAttributes` | - | Merged onto generated button props |

### UseViraPasswordResult

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputProps` | `InputHTMLAttributes` | Includes `type` password/text, `id`, a11y |
| `btnProps` | `ButtonHTMLAttributes` | `type="button"`, ARIA, children (icon) |
| `isVisible` | `boolean` | Current visibility |
| `toggle` | `() => void` | Flip visibility |
| `setVisible` | `(visible: boolean) => void` | Imperative set |

## Accessibility defaults

- Button: `type="button"`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-controls` (input id), `aria-label` for show/hide
- Input: linked id; type switches between `password` and `text`
- Prop merge preserves and composes user `onClick` / `onChange` / `className`

## Helpers / exports

- `useViraPassword`
- `getInputType`, `getButtonAriaAttributes`, `getInputAriaAttributes`
- `EyeIcon`, `EyeOffIcon`
- `mergeProps` (also used internally)
